subject: Future Tech
title: The SAE Levels Explained
description: A fast breakdown of The SAE Levels Explained for builders.

hook.text: The SAE defined 6 levels of driving autonomy, from 0 to 5. Most cars today are stuck at Level 2.

buildup.text: Level 0: no automation. Level 1: cruise control or lane assist. Level 2: both together, but the human must stay alert.

discovery.text: Level 3: the car drives itself in specific conditions and the human can look away.

twist.text: Level 5 means autonomous everywhere, in any condition, with no steering wheel needed. No company has achieved this yet.

climax.text: The jump from Level 2 to Level 3 is enormous. It shifts legal liability from driver to manufacturer.

punchline.text: Six levels. The gap between 2 and 3 is a legal canyon.

quiz.question: What fundamentally changes at SAE Level 3?
options: Legal liability shifts from driver to manufacturer
The car uses lidar for the first time
